messages:
Marta: Heads-up — scheduling a staggered cold-boot for the 'gradient' GPU pool in us-west2a this Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Plan is to cold-reboot racks 5→7 sequentially to apply a BMC + NIC firmware combo that resolves high-rate packet drops. Expect per-rack drain + reboot ~20-30m; full window mainly for verification and warm-up.
Ashish: Is there a public-facing impact? any chance of 429s or increased generation latency for hosted API customers? :thinking:
Marta: Shouldn't see 429s. We'll route new sessions off the draining racks to our hotpool and scale up a few on-demand nodes as short-term backfill. That will increase queuing for a subset of long-tail requests but we expect P95 latency uptick ~5–15% for ~15–30m while warm caches refill.
Jules: Cost question — how many GPUs are we pushing to the hotpool and for how long? rough $$$ estimate pls.
Marta: We'll push ~48 GPUs to the hotpool for ~2h total (includes warm-up). Ballpark incremental infra cost ~ $1,200 for the window (on-demand uplift + egress). Ops cost may vary if we have to extend.
Ops-Jen: Runbook checkpoint — who is owner for the rack sequence and rollback? Also, add support contact for customers running long-running batch jobs.
Marta: Owner is me for orchestration; Miguel will run the backfill scripts and confirm warm cache metrics. If a rack fails to come up cleanly we rollback firmware via BMC image revert and re-add to pool only after health checks.
Miguel: I'll trigger the backfill job and monitor KV cache hit-rate. I'll post progress in this thread.
Kevin: There's a customer (Customer-A) with big nightly embeddings in that region. @support-team please pre-emptively DM them and offer to reschedule their runs if they'd prefer 0-risk.
sre-bot: maintenance-scheduler: Created maintenance event 1798765432 in calendar (label: gradient-coldboot-usw2a). Preflight checks: netpol, node-drain hooks OK. Reminder notifications queued.
Marta: Ops runbook (short):
```
1) announce in #announcements + #support (30m before)
2) cordon nodes in rack X: kubectl cordon <node>
3) drain with grace=120s: drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
4) power-cycle via bmc-tool and flash NIC/BMC
5) uncordon after health checks and warmup
6) monitor p95/p99 and KV cache hit-rate
7) rollback if kernel panic or >3 failed nodes in rack
```
Marta: We'll do canary on rack 5 first (one GPU server), monitor 15m, then proceed to 6 and 7. If any unexpected net drops or licensing errors happen we abort and escalate.
Jules: Please attach the cost center tag to the temporary on-demand hosts so finance can attribute the ~$1.2k spike.
Marta: Done — I'll add tag "maintenance:gradient-2026-11-18" and include cost center.
Miguel: Backfill script is ready; I'll run a dry-run tonight against a non-prod pool and post metrics.
deploy-bot: deploy-check: preflight scripts passed (draino v2.1 present, bmc-tool ping ok). No blockers.
Marta: Thanks — final ask: @support, can someone draft the short customer-facing blurb? I'll post infra details in #announcements. We'll reconvene here 30m before start to confirm go/no-go.
